sources.title: Active Grandparenting
sources.supports: Adapted chapter-ten text on ageing, repair, maintenance, physical activity, and the active-grandparent hypothesis.

sources.title: Is Exercise Really Medicine? An Evolutionary Perspective
sources.author_or_publisher: Daniel E. Lieberman; Current Sports Medicine Reports
sources.supports: Peer-reviewed precursor to the exercise-paradox, mismatch, trade-off, and no-single-evolved-dose arguments.
sources.limitations: The author's own earlier scholarly argument.

sources.title: Review of Exercised
sources.author_or_publisher: Haider J. Warraich; Evolution, Medicine, and Public Health
sources.supports: Physician assessment of the evolutionary synthesis, motivation problem, health evidence, empathy, clarity, and examples.
sources.limitations: Favourable review, not verification of every cited study.

sources.title: Exercised: The Science of Physical Activity, Rest and Health
sources.supports: Full-book review, physical-activity definitions, field comparisons, prose, and critique of the exercise distinction.
sources.limitations: Single critical review with limited audit of health outcomes.

sources.title: Exercised
sources.supports: Natural-history framing, accessible delivery, anthropological detail, limited prescriptiveness, and publication data.

sources.title: Exercised
sources.supports: Independent description of the natural history, disease reference, persuasion value, and absence of a workout plan.

sources.title: Exercised — fitness myths exploded
sources.supports: Independent assessment of entertainment, information value, running expertise, and myth-busting delivery.

sources.title: WHO Guidelines on Physical Activity and Sedentary Behaviour
sources.supports: Independent evidence-based activity, strength, older-adult, and sedentary-behaviour guidance and dose ranges.
sources.limitations: Population guidance; individual needs and contraindications vary.

sources.title: The Association of Recreational and Competitive Running With Hip and Knee Osteoarthritis
sources.author_or_publisher: Journal of Orthopaedic & Sports Physical Therapy via PubMed
sources.supports: Meta-analysis finding lower observed osteoarthritis occurrence in recreational runners, with causal and confounding limits.
sources.limitations: Mostly observational evidence; prior injury and selection complicate causal interpretation.

sources.title: The Active Grandparent Hypothesis
sources.author_or_publisher: Daniel E. Lieberman et al.; Proceedings of the National Academy of Sciences
sources.supports: Formal development of the evolutionary hypothesis connecting later-life activity, extended human healthspan, repair, and intergenerational provisioning.
sources.limitations: Hypothesis and synthesis co-authored by Lieberman, not direct proof of one evolutionary pathway.

sources.title: Exercised
sources.supports: Large reader aggregate and recurring praise for insight and humour alongside criticism that the practical conclusion is simple relative to the length.
sources.limitations: Self-selected, merged editions, no control for expertise or completion.

workflow.coverage_notes: Searchable primary preview, the full contents, a substantial author interview, an adapted chapter, the peer-reviewed precursor and sequel hypothesis, independent clinical guidelines and meta-analysis, and four professional or specialist reviews cover every part. No uninterrupted lawful full text was used.
next_steps: Optional: check each disease-specific endnote against an owner-supplied copy and current clinical reviews before promoting coverage to full-book.
